chunks.title: Subscription Tiers & Pricing
chunks.content: NexaOps offers three plans: Starter at $299/month (up to 10 seats, 5,000 workflow runs/month), Growth at $899/month (up to 50 seats, 50,000 runs/month, CRM integrations, SSO), and Enterprise with custom volume pricing starting at $2,400/month (unlimited seats, dedicated VPC, 99.99% SLA, 24/7 TAM). Annual billing provides an 18% discount.

chunks.title: Customer ROI & Case Studies
chunks.content: On average, mid-market B2B teams save 14 hours per rep per week and reduce lead response latency from 4 hours to under 30 seconds. Case study: FinServe Corp (120 reps) increased qualified pipeline by 38% within 60 days and achieved full payback in 6 weeks.

chunks.title: Security, Compliance & Data Privacy
chunks.content: NexaOps is SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 27001 compliant, and GDPR/DPDP ready. All audio, transcripts, and CRM payloads are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3 / SRTP) and at rest (AES-256). Automatic PII redaction masks credit cards, SSNs, and phone numbers before LLM logging, and zero customer data is used to train public foundation models.

chunks.title: CRM, Calendar & Telephony Integrations
chunks.content: Native bi-directional sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 Outlook, Slack, and Twilio/SIP trunks. Deployment takes under 45 minutes using OAuth 2.0 connectors or REST/GraphQL webhooks.

chunks.title: Implementation Timeline & Support
chunks.content: Standard Growth onboarding completes in 5 business days including CRM mapping, knowledge base ingestion, and voice persona tuning. Enterprise deployments with custom SSO and VPC peering complete in 2 to 3 weeks with a dedicated Solutions Architect.

chunks.title: Multilingual Voice & Latency Performance
chunks.content: Supports real-time voice conversations in 25+ languages including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, and German with automatic mid-call language switching and sub-500ms turn-around latency using streaming STT and neural TTS.

chunks.title: Differentiation vs Legacy Dialers & Chatbots
chunks.content: Unlike rule-based IVRs or text chatbots, NexaOps handles natural interruptions (barge-in), grounds every product claim in verified RAG documents, scores BANT qualification live, and books confirmed calendar slots directly into the rep's CRM during the call.

chunks.title: Pilot Program & Risk-Free Proof of Value
chunks.content: Qualified teams can run a 14-day guided Proof of Value pilot on one sales queue with pre-configured CRM sync and a 30-day money-back guarantee on annual Growth plans. Month-to-month contracts are available on Starter and Growth.
